repositories.description: 让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。
Non-invasive MCP accelerator plugin for Google Antigravity (CLI/Desktop/IDE): cuts LLM turns (-34%), token quota (-31%), and upload traffic (-40%) without affecting native UI or diffs.
Open-source, local-first AI agent team for your desktop: multi-agent group chats, computer use, browser, MCP, routines and approvals. macOS, Windows, Linux + Android. Built on pi.
Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
Reverse-engineer any video, shot by shot: filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. Breakdowns in the open VIDEO.md format. 逆向一切视频，逐个镜头看是拍的、AI 生成的还是代码做的，再告诉你怎么复刻；拆解结果按 VIDEO.md 格式输出。
A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.

🛡️ BLA (bla-agents / Blind LLM Agents) — Open-source Blue Defense MCP server & CLI protecting JS/TS, Electron ASAR, WASM, Python, Native Binaries, SQLite, GGUF/Safetensors & Android DEX against AI reverse-engineering agents (REA).
Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile Python, Node or Ruby apps, port the hot functions with your coding agent, prove they behave the same.

MR Office — the open-source editors of the AI office suite closest to Microsoft Office: documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF and code in the browser. Copilot in every editor edits real Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with you; an MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex create and edit them; embed it in your app with one line.
Write an app once. It runs natively on the web, macOS, iOS, and Linux, and an AI agent can build it, run it, see it, and test it on every one of them.
The AI-native engine for teams and their agents. Multi-harness, multi-agent, self-hosted.
An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.

Linger is An Open-Source Personal Agent That Runs Fully on Your PC.  We aim to break Big Tech’s grip on AI by bringing powerful local AI to everyday computers through efficient model–harness co-design, so everyone can run their own.
Towards a More Autonomous Agent System
Xbox Series compatibility layer for Windows - runs console game code natively, reimplements the console system libraries and recompiles RDNA2 shaders to DXIL
